cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: What Really Happened?
cards.instruction: Find the truth by comparing details, repeating questions, and testing which parts of the story remain consistent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. For this missing-parcel form: was it a bag or a box? You've said both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A bag, I think. I carried it by the handles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Describe the handles. Were they attached to fabric or cardboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cardboard. It had a rigid lid, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why 'bag'? Tell me again what you carried. Was the box inside something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For this missing-parcel form: was it a bag or a box? You've said both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A bag, I think. I carried it by the handles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Describe the handles. Were they attached to fabric or cardboard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cardboard. It had a rigid lid, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why 'bag'? Tell me again what you carried. Was the box inside something?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're claiming for your lost bag. At four, were you on the bus or buying coffee? You've told me both.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Coffee. Can we finish the form?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Was the bag beside you when you paid?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. The driver waited while I ran in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So both fit. Tell me the boarding bit again: did the bag come back out with you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's asking who broke her vase. Will you tell her, or keep your promise to your little brother?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's blaming the cleaner. I can't let that happen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Clear the cleaner. Do you have to name me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's asked me directly whether you did it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then are you answering her, or keeping the promise I trusted you with?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The client asked who wrote our pitch. Will you tell her I copied it, or protect our partnership?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can withdraw it together.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll withdraw it. Will you keep my name out?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked whether you copied it. Withdrawing doesn't answer her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then before you say yes, decide whether we're still partners when she puts down the phone.
